message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a large, flat, rectangular wooden board painted to resemble a multi-story arched building in shades of reddish-orange and brown. The board, which sits on a small wooden platform supported by a simple wooden brace on the left, serves as a backdrop. On the painted building, there are six arched windows with black frames and several columns. The Arabic word "فندق" is inscribed in yellow above the central doorway.

In the foreground, a man and a woman stand facing the board with their backs to the viewer. The man, on the left, wears a white skullcap, a long-sleeved light-colored shirt, and light-colored pants. A dark strap crosses his shoulder, and he carries a black suitcase in his right hand. The woman, on the right, is clad in a white hijab and a long white garment.

Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO" with "14-20 SEPTEMBER 2015" below. The central headlines read "PENCURI TAMU TUHAN" and "Permainan anggota DPR terungkap dalam pengusutan dugaan korupsi-haji Suryadharma Ali." Additional text at the top and bottom includes "SELINGAN: BUKU-BUKU YANG TELANTAR," "PENUMPANG GELAP PAKET KEBIJAKAN," "RP 39.500," and a barcode.
